stacking_modes.reject: existing active target+spell instance rejects application
stacking_modes.refresh: stable existing identity receives new magnitude, duration, and tick origin
stacking_modes.replace: existing instances terminate before new instance is created
stacking_modes.independent: new identity allowed up to evidence-backed maximum stack count

determinism.expiration_rule: periodic ticks execute only when due_tick < expires_tick
determinism.clock_rule: world tick is monotonic and cannot regress
determinism.identity_rule: effect IDs are unique and terminal states cannot be re-entered

safe_fallback: Reject application when duration, tick interval, stacking, maximum stacks, ownership, or persistence semantics are not promoted.
native_dependencies: exact native status meanings for production spell records
exact duration and tick values for unresolved spells including spell.1304
native effect persistence across logout, restart, and world reset
native same-tick ordering against death, movement, regeneration, and cast completion
